newsitem.title: USA: Firstar sees Q4 EPS of about $0.95.
newsitem.headline: Firstar sees Q4 EPS of about $0.95.

text.p: Firstar Corp on Thursday estimated its fourth-quarter earnings will approximate $0.95 per share, excluding any one-time gains.
It said this estimate is $0.08 per share less than the cnsensus among analysts. The company said fourth-quarter net income is expected to exceed $70 million.
Chairman Roger Fitzsimonds in a statement said, "I continue to be comfortable with analyst estimates of 1997 earnings of about $4.55 per share."
In the 1995 fourth quarter, Firstar posted earnings of $0.95 per share.

The $19.9 billion financial services company cited transition expenses associated with implementation of a restructuring project and recent acquisitions, along with continued modest declines in commercial loan outstandings.
Although credit card chargeoffs in the quarter are expected to be in line with results for the card industry overall, they will remain higher than Firstar's historic levels, the company added.

"While the first half of 1997 may be affected by the same factors that have slowed earnings growth during the second half of 1996, we expect significant strengthening of our earnings per share during the second half of 1997 following completion of our restructuring project," said Fitzsimonds.
Firstar said its goals include enhancing fee revenue, improving customer service and reducing costs.
